Added strict MultiPolygon component topology validation: reject touching/intersecting components and overlapping filled interiors; preserve valid island-in-hole cases.
Added regression tests for overlapping/touching MultiPolygon components and valid disjoint/island-in-hole components.
Added a dedicated branch-scoped GIS GitHub Actions workflow for npm run test:geospatial and TypeScript typecheck.

Hardened geospatial snapshot validation across every boundary history: reject malformed history/record shapes, map-key/entity mismatches, duplicate record IDs, duplicate or out-of-order versions, and multiple ACTIVE versions; added durable-recovery regression coverage.
Updated boundary bbox overlap diagnostics to exclude entity histories with multiple ACTIVE versions rather than arbitrarily selecting the first; added regression coverage.

Added durable snapshot validation for canonical geometry, simplified geometry and exact persisted bounding-box consistency; added malformed geometry, malformed simplified geometry and stale bbox regression cases.

Audited valuation and spatial market summary consumers: valuation now requires an explicit valid boundary version ID/version; market summary returns null boundary metadata instead of synthesizing version 1 when no unique ACTIVE boundary exists.
Hardened sub-neighborhood assignment: a point on a micro-neighborhood edge does not inherit its sub-neighborhood ID, and any matched active boundary edge prevents an interior valuation result.
Fixed a point-resolution integrity gap: a parent-neighborhood interior no longer masks a matched sub-neighborhood boundary edge; edge matches do not emit a sub-neighborhood ID.
Added a regression proving a point on a sub-neighborhood edge is marked RESOLVED_ON_EDGE and rejected by valuation feature generation.
Fixed bbox overlap diagnostics to require exactly one ACTIVE record across the complete entity history before filtering by city or boundary level; added a mixed-metadata duplicate-ACTIVE regression.
